id: Re-Degradation Reveals Resolution | CVPR 2027 | addendum v8 | registered after run 8 and before run 9
scope: Frozen v1.0 and addenda v2-v7 stay exactly as they are and the 88 checkpoints of runs 1-8 are reused unchanged; every rule of v1.0-v7 keeps its verdict in the ledger. Addendum v8 (i) tests the floor-sensitivity index on eight ImageNet classifiers no run has used, with predictions registered from the labelled source before any target image is read (block B27, rules U1-U3), on ImageNet-C archive images no run has used; (ii) replicates the storage-matched plug-in and the storage-matched attribution score on those classifiers and images (U4-U8); (iii) reports how the v1.0 fit check depends on the number of target images (U12); and (iv) registers the claims map v8, in which Claim 5 lists its tests apart from the documented limits, and the order of the paper.
motivation: run 8: the floor-sensitivity index computed on the labelled source predicted 4 of 4 classifiers (W9) and where the floating-point plug-in failed on fresh archive images (W10, 4 of 4), but the four classifiers are the ones whose run-7 behaviour defined the index and its 4 pp threshold, so W9 and W10 confirmed the prediction on new images, not on new models

run 8: rounding the re-degraded source to 8 bits was registered as negligible (W4) and was not: on the 8-bit targets it lowered the error of all 7 estimators (ATC 4.97 -> 2.31 pp, COTT 2.57 -> 0.98 pp), and the floating-point plug-in failed even there (W3, 0 of 7); at matched blur the confidence-accuracy gap of ConvNeXt-T was +2.4 pp on floating-point images, +9.5 pp on the same images in 8 bits and +13.1 pp as JPEG (Swin-T: +3.2, +13.8, +14.2 pp)

run 8: on fresh archive images the storage-matched plug-in lowered the error of the five confidence-based estimators, significantly for four (W5 PARTIAL, 4 of 7 with AE-LS and MaNo unchanged); the strongest storage-matched plug-in matched the strongest published estimator there (COT@s_hat v7 2.18 vs NucNorm 1.88 pp, 95% CI of the difference containing 0)
run 8: the storage-matched attribution score tracked the labelled share on 9 fresh settings (W8: rho 0.98, median |phi_v7 - share_v7| 0.03 vs 0.20 for the floating-point phi)

run 8: the v1.0 fit check flagged 92-100% of the ImageNet conditions, Gaussian blur included, while the identified level stayed accurate (Spearman rho 1.00 with the PSF variance, median relative error 0.12-0.14); each condition used 2,000 target images, far more than in the blocks where the check was calibrated

unseen_classifiers.why: eight public ImageNet-1k classifiers that no run of this notebook has used, chosen for architectural and training diversity (larger ConvNeXt and Swin models, a ViT and a DeiT at base size, an EfficientNet, a RegNet, a MobileNet, and ResNet-50 trained with the A1 recipe); their floor sensitivity is unknown until stage 1 computes it
unseen_classifiers.preprocessing: the B18 pipeline (224-px images as stored), normalised with each model's own mean and standard deviation from its timm pretrained configuration; the input of the final linear layer gives the features and the layer gives the logits
unseen_classifiers.source: A, the ImageNetV2 labelled half of B18 (same split and bank tag as B24: the same source grids, meta-sets, noise fields and calibration subsample)
unseen_classifiers.targets: the ImageNet-C blur archive (defocus, glass, motion, zoom; severities 1-5): per class the validation images ranked 11-15 by the keyed hash of B18 (ranks 1-5 were used in run 7, ranks 6-10 in run 8), the same 5,000 images in every condition; 20 conditions
unseen_classifiers.temperature: one temperature per classifier, fitted by NLL on the clean labelled source (as v6)
unseen_classifiers.estimators: as B24: the 12 published estimators, the v6 plug-ins (floating-point re-degradation), the v7 plug-ins (storage-matched), phi and phi_v7, both switches and blends, pre-T and post-T

registration.stage_1: before any B27 target image is read, for every unseen classifier: the floor-sensitivity index on the labelled source A alone (post-T; the v7 definition, mean over s in {1, 4, 16} px^2 of gap(s, 3 DN) - gap(s, 0)), the temperature and the clean accuracy
registration.prediction: FSI >= 4 pp (floor-sensitive): the floating-point plug-in raises the error on the fresh archive images, i.e. the mean over the 7 estimators of MAE(X@s_hat v6) - MAE(X) (post-T) is > 0; FSI < 4 pp: it does not (<= 0)
registration.record: the predictions are written to a checkpointed registration record (part 'registration' of B27) with the SHA-256 of their canonical JSON and the time, and printed, before stage 2 reads any target image; a session that resumes B27 reuses the record and never recomputes it
registration.stage_2: the identification of the 20 target conditions (pixels only), the fit-check analysis, then one pass per classifier with the full source bank; the bank's FSI must equal the registered value (rule U1)

fit_check_n.question: whether the v1.0 fit check flags ImageNet conditions because the blur model is wrong or because 2,000 images give the test enough power to reject a model that is close enough for identification
fit_check_n.design: Gaussian blur of B at severities 1-5 (the B18 keyed streams, 8-bit, no JPEG) and the five fresh archive defocus conditions; per condition a keyed pool of 2,000 target images; the v1.0 fit check and the identified level on keyed subsamples of n = 125, 250, 500, 1,000 and 2,000 images (five subsamples per n below 2,000)
fit_check_n.reported: the flag rate and the median relative level error against the Gaussian-equivalent PSF variance, as functions of n (rule U12; not a pass/fail rule)

U1.test: registration integrity: the registration record precedes stage 2 and, for each of the 8 unseen classifiers, the FSI of the stage-2 bank equals the registered FSI within 0.01 pp; PASS when both hold for all 8

U2.test: primary test of the index on unseen classifiers: the registered prediction agrees with the observed effect of the floating-point plug-in on the fresh archive images (post-T), i.e. the sign of the mean over the 7 estimators of MAE(X@s_hat v6) - MAE(X); PASS >= 7/8 agree with >= 2 classifiers in each predicted class; PARTIAL >= 6/8 agree, or >= 7/8 with fewer than 2 classifiers in a predicted class; FAIL otherwise

U3.test: across the 8 unseen classifiers, Spearman rho between the registered FSI and the observed mean change of U2; PASS rho >= 0.6 with one-sided exact permutation p < 0.05; PARTIAL rho >= 0.3; FAIL otherwise

U4.test: the storage-matched plug-in on unseen classifiers and images (the scope of Claim 3): post-T, X@s_hat v7 < X for the five confidence-based estimators (ATC, ATC-NE, DoC, COT, COTT), one-sided Wilcoxon on paired cells (classifier x condition), Holm over the 5; PASS >= 4/5 with p < 0.01, PARTIAL >= 3/5

U5.test: the W5 form on unseen classifiers and images: post-T, X@s_hat v7 < X for the 7 pairs (with AE-LS and MaNo), one-sided Wilcoxon, Holm over the 7; PASS >= 5/7 with p < 0.01, PARTIAL >= 3/7

U6.test: the storage step removes the harm: pooled over the unseen classifiers registered as floor-sensitive (post-T), X@s_hat v7 < X@s_hat v6 for >= 4 of the five confidence-based estimators (one-sided Wilcoxon, Holm, p < 0.01), and for each of them the mean change of v7 over the 7 estimators is <= 0; PARTIAL when one of the two holds; INCONCLUSIVE when fewer than 2 unseen classifiers are registered as floor-sensitive

U7.test: storage-matched attribution on unseen classifiers: settings = (family, classifier) pooled over severities, counting when >= 3 of the 5 cells have a labelled drop > 0.02; (a) Spearman rho between the per-setting median phi_v7 and the median share_v7 >= 0.8 with one-sided p < 0.01; (b) median over settings of |phi_v7 - share_v7| <= 0.10; PASS both, PARTIAL one

U8.test: storage read-back: every fresh archive condition of B27 is read as JPEG quality 85 with 4:2:0 subsampling, with an exact table match for >= 99% of its files

reported.U9: the FSI per level (pre-T and post-T), the temperature and the clean accuracy of every unseen classifier
reported.U10: per unseen classifier (post-T): the MAE of X, X@s_hat v6 and X@s_hat v7 for the 7 estimators, the strongest published estimator and the strongest storage-matched plug-in
reported.U11: all twelve ImageNet classifiers (the four of B24 on archive ranks 6-10, the eight of B27 on ranks 11-15): the FSI against the observed mean change of the floating-point and of the storage-matched plug-in, with Spearman rho (descriptive: the four of B24 defined the index)
reported.U12: the v1.0 fit check against the number of target images (fit_check_n)

Claim 1.statement: Identification: re-degradation by the exact heat semigroup identifies a calibrated blur level in px^2 without labels (knee law, half-energy law, effective resolution of real 25 vs 50 cm products), on blur the method did not generate (standard corruption PSFs up to ImageNet, real ground-sample-distance and off-nadir shifts) and against blind kernel estimation

Claim 2.statement: Attribution: phi says without labels how much of an accuracy drop the identified blur explains; it ranks fresh ImageNet settings, and with the storage-matched re-degradation its level tracks the labelled share, on unseen classifiers too

Claim 3.statement: Plug-in under a matched pipeline: calibrating a confidence-based estimator on the source re-degraded to s_hat lowers its error when the re-degradation reproduces how the target was formed (blur, and the storage step read from the files): official CIFAR-10-C and CIFAR-100-C files, the real fMoW resolution shift, standard corruptions, and ImageNet-C with the storage step matched, on unseen classifiers too

Claim 4.statement: No harm by construction: the plug-ins are exact identities when no blur is identified, and the switches keep shifts that are not mainly blur unharmed

Claim 5.statement: Boundaries and their diagnosis: a re-degradation that misses the target's storage step (the 8-bit floor included) fails for floor-sensitive classifiers, which the labelled source alone reveals, on classifiers it has never seen; blur that is a minority of a real shift limits the gain, and distribution-matching estimators do not gain
Claim 5.limits_note: documented limits: rules registered in v2-v7 as tests of the plug-in that failed or were partial; the v7 map (before run 8) counted seven of them (Q5, Q8, Q11, L8, V3, Q10, P4) as tests of Claim 5 and W3, W4 as tests of Claim 3; the v8 map (before run 9) lists all nine with Claim 5, where they mark the boundary, and does not count them as passed or failed tests
